newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-SCOTLAND FANS GET FREE TICKETS TO ESTONIA REPLAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCOTLAND FANS GET FREE TICKETS TO ESTONIA REPLAY.

text.p: Scotland fans who travelled to Tallinn for their team's abandoned World Cup qualifier against Estonia will receive free tickets to the replay, FIFA said on Wednesday.
The replay is scheduled for Monaco on February 11 next year.
The group four match, which was originally scheduled for October 4, was awarded to Scotland when Estonia did not appear for the kickoff.
FIFA, world soccer's governing body, upheld an Estonia appeal against the decision and ordered a replay.
Estonia will retain the television and advertising rights while the French Football Federation will retain the gate receipts from which costs will be deducted.
